## Backtest

```{python}
s, bm = bt["strategy"], bt["benchmark"]
st, sb = perf_stats(s, 252), perf_stats(bm, 252)
horizon_stat_tiles(s, 252, static=[("Time in market (full history)", f'{meta()["btc"]["backtest_exposure"]:.0%}', "")])
```

<p class="asof">Daily, `{python} f"{bt.index[0]:%b %Y}"` to `{python} f"{bt.index[-1]:%b %Y}"`. Before transaction costs. When the strategy is flat (or partly invested) the cash earns the overnight fed funds rate (rate × days / 365). The benchmark is buy-and-hold BTC.</p>


## How it works

::: {.method}
- **Universe:** bitcoin (BTC/USD), traded long or flat. The strategy never goes short.
- **Regimes:** a slow, lagged volatility band sorts the market into bullish, neutral and bearish regimes. A breakout above the band starts a bull regime, and a break below starts a bear regime.
- **Entry and exit:** inside a regime, a faster trend filter confirms or cancels exposure. The strategy holds a position only when the regime and the short-term trend agree.
- **Execution:** signals are smoothed and positions move in half steps, which cuts whipsaw trades.
- **Rebalance:** daily, at the close.
:::

:::
